description: Defines the XFontStretch struct to describe font stretch degrees within the PDFsharp library, including methods for conversion, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: XFontStretch
classes.description: A struct representing font stretch degrees, encapsulating the stretch value and providing comparison, conversion, and string formatting functionalities.

methods.name: FromOpenTypeStretch
methods.description: Creates an XFontStretch instance from an OpenType usStretchClass value, ensuring the input is within valid range.

methods.name: ToOpenTypeStretch
methods.description: Returns the usStretchClass value corresponding to this XFontStretch instance.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two XFontStretch instances, returning an integer indicating their relative order.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the XFontStretch instance.
